resources.string: Enable this only for invented questions and answers, without names, health information, or information about real people. Text and recent history are sent to Meta along with general communication options and, when applicable, a public source. AINGEL does not automatically detect personal information. It turns off when switching profiles or signing out; it does not enable the camera or the private media test.
I agree to use only invented content and enable the test conversation
Meta test enabled: use only invented content without personal information. AINGEL does not detect sensitive data.
Private test enabled: only your own images and voice, without other people or sensitive content. They are sent to Meta.
Only the profile owner can enable this test. Save permission to send to Meta and the camera or microphone permission you want to use. The server must have the private test enabled.

By enabling this test, I declare that I will use only my own images and voice, without other people or sensitive content. Images and audio are sent to Meta. AINGEL does not automatically detect people or sensitive data. General conversation with Meta is disabled during this test. The test turns off when switching profiles or signing out.
I agree and enable the private test for this profile
First save the Meta authorization and camera or microphone authorization for your owner profile.
The server did not authorize this test or the profile lacks the required permissions.
Test mode: my general questions are made up and I allow sending them to Meta.

Sent: your general questions in this conversation (up to 5 earlier ones) and address options (formal, short sentences, pace). If the question matches a MedlinePlus topic, its public summary too. Not sent: your name, notes, routines, messages or memories — the phone answers those itself. History lives only on this screen and is cleared when you leave or with “Clear conversation”.
This account did not authorize sending data to Meta. Enable it on the web, in Personalize.
I can\'t reach Meta\'s model right now. I can still help with today\'s routines, your messages and your memories.
That was many questions in a row. Please wait a minute.
Conversation with Meta is not available in this configuration. You can continue using local features.
What do I need to do today?
Test mode · MedlinePlus text, no model
Generated by Meta Muse Spark · no source consulted
Generated by Meta Muse Spark from a MedlinePlus summary
Point at what you want me to see
Camera on · the image is not stored
The image is a test (no people or real data) and I allow sending it to Meta for analysis.
I didn\'t find %1$s in this image.
Test mode: the image was not analysed.
Don\'t rely on this answer to move around safely.
The server did not authorize this image. Check the authorizations and test mode in Settings.
I couldn\'t analyse the image right now. Please try again.
Voice to signs and signs to voice or text
I heard nothing. Tap to try again.
Camera open · AINGEL can\'t recognise signs on its own yet
Camera on · the image is not stored or sent
AINGEL can\'t recognise signs from the camera yet. Tap the signs of your message.
Text for the other person (you can correct it)

Signs designed by AINGEL (alphabet, numbers, 43 words and actions), pending validation with Deaf LSEC signers. Sentences use a simple rule, not full LSEC grammar. AINGEL does not replace an interpreter.
Tap the signs to build your message
Type a sentence and AINGEL signs it
Done. Tap ↻ to see it again.
I found no words to sign
Blue: has a sign · Gold: fingerspelled · Struck out: dropped. Time goes first and the question last.
%1$s organizes this reminder. Ask %2$s if you need it changed.
AINGEL can\'t recognise signs from the camera yet. Tap the signs you make:
AINGEL will describe aloud what is in front of the rear camera whenever the scene changes, also with the phone locked. A permanent notification lets you stop it.
Without notification permission I can\'t stay with you in the background.
Audio output, microphone and voice control
Hello. This is how my voice sounds.
Android decides which microphone dictation uses; AINGEL asks for the one you choose, but some headsets may still use the phone\'s.
Say «%1$s» and AINGEL listens without touching the screen
Works while AINGEL\'s home screen is open. AINGEL answers to the phrase; it does not identify who says it.
Done, %1$s. I know your phrase now.
I didn\'t hear «%1$s». Let\'s try again.
Audio is not stored. AINGEL recognises the phrase, not your voice.
Generated by Meta Muse Spark with web search
Starting continuous watching. I\'ll tell you what I see.
I need permission to use the camera. Allow it and ask me again.
Signs chosen from the meaning of the sentence (Meta), with AINGEL\'s vocabulary.
AINGEL is signing it · microphone paused
To look, open the phone: the camera on this side points at you.
AINGEL opens the camera when asked: describe, find objects, continuous watching. Images are not stored.
AINGEL listens to talk, translate to signs, caption and answer «Hola AINGEL». Audio is not stored.
Send data to Meta to answer

The questions, images and audio to analyse, and the support needs and allergies, are sent to Meta Muse Spark. While the account uses free credits, Meta warns it may use that content to improve its products. Names, routines, messages and memories are not sent.
Without these, AINGEL still works with routines, messages and memories. They can be changed on the web, in Personalize.
